root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ -d "$root/ai-workflow/memory" ] || exit 0; d="$root/.workbench"; [ -n "$(find "$d/progress.checked" -mmin -15 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; for py in python3 python; do "$py" -c 'import workflow_kit.tools.progress_nudge' >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; py=; done; if [ -n "$py" ]; then cd "$root" && "$py" -m workflow_kit progress-nudge --hook PostToolUse 2>/dev/null; else mkdir -p "$d" && { [ -f "$d/.gitignore" ] || printf '*\n' > "$d/.gitignore"; } && touch "$d/progress.checked"; fi; true
